scope: Supplemental baseline-only direction check; not the preregistered NPO effect test.
metric: forget10 truth_ratio_score; larger values indicate less distinction between paraphrased and perturbed answer likelihoods under the locked formula.
interpretation: The oracle baseline has a higher mean forget10 score than the full checkpoint. A positive NPO-minus-full change is directionally consistent with this oracle contrast, but alone does not establish that the NPO adapter moved closer to the oracle.
